name: HaloShop_Potion
note: Shop (24 x 15 x 18). Rect body 19 x 13, one 10-stud storey, centred arched door with lantern pedestals, an arched display window each side (the 2D has ONE wide potion-shelf window left of an off-centre door: generator door is always centred, so the shopfront is mirrored), gold corner pilasters, blue/white awning, two corner planters with topiary, big gold ribbed dome with a spike finial on a short round base (drum_dome R 5.8, 0.8 high, no windows). Left out on purpose: the two small arched windows beside the sign (they sit on an upper tier of only ~3 studs; a second storey would push the shop far over the 18-stud plan height). Missing: gold sign plaque, off-centre door, potion shelves, cauldron by the door, ivy garlands, round sign medallions on the plinth (see generator_gaps.md). Built from art/review/img3/HaloShop_Potion_check.jpg (2D panel); the 2D PNG is not in the worktree.
